## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For legacy imports, identify the
source area and any publication sanitization; do not imply a new implementation.

## Dependencies

State the intended base and prerequisite PRs, or say none.

## Verification

List commands executed and results. Distinguish static inspection, executed
tests, runtime verification and unperformed checks. Record secret-scan scope.

## Limitations

Document known defects, excluded private material and work needing a later phase.
